@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: It is illegal to d______p any kind of trash or waste into rivers in our country.
= dump
~詞義 dump（v.）傾倒(廢棄物)
~原文 It is illegal to dump any kind of trash or waste into rivers in our country.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The current mayor is very confident that he will win the e______n again.
= election
~詞義 election（n.）選舉
~原文 The current mayor is very confident that he will win the election again.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: My mother always treats us with patience and kindness, and she seldom loses her t______r.
= temper
~詞義 temper（n.）脾氣
~原文 My mother always treats us with patience and kindness, and she seldom loses her temper.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: A lack of exercise and bad eating habits may w______n your body and lead to health problems.
= weaken
~詞義 weaken（v.）使虛弱
~原文 A lack of exercise and bad eating habits may weaken your body and lead to health problems.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: We should be t______l for what we have and try not to waste anything.
= thankful
~詞義 thankful（adj.）感謝的
~原文 We should be thankful for what we have and try not to waste anything.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Bob hasn't cleaned his desk for a long time, so it is covered in ______.
A: bush
B: yolk
C: chest
D: dust
= D
~詞義 dust（n.）灰塵
~原文 Bob hasn't cleaned his desk for a long time, so it is covered in dust.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Most of the products manufactured in this factory are for ______. Only a small percentage are for domestic use.
A: cherry
B: shovel
C: export
D: tide
= C
~詞義 export（n.）出口
~原文 Most of the products manufactured in this factory are for export. Only a small percentage are for domestic use.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: For their tenth wedding anniversary, the Wangs plan to ______ at a very fancy restaurant.
A: sigh
B: buzz
C: elect
D: dine
= D
~詞義 dine（v.）用餐
~原文 For their tenth wedding anniversary, the Wangs plan to dine at a very fancy restaurant.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The lifeguard's loud ______ immediately caught the swimmers' attention and stopped them from going too far.
A: whistle
B: zipper
C: cupboard
D: bushfire
= A
~詞義 whistle（n.）哨聲
~原文 The lifeguard's loud whistle immediately caught the swimmers' attention and stopped them from going too far.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Miranda ______ and shook her head. She didn't know how to deal with the problem.
A: buzzed
B: sighed
C: dipped
D: exported
= B
~詞義 sigh（v.）嘆氣
~原文 Miranda sighed and shook her head. She didn't know how to deal with the problem.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: tailor
B: buzzing
C: tent
D: zone
E: dip
F: dusting

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: There was a fly ______ around our heads all morning.
= B
~詞義 buzz（v.）嗡嗡叫
~原文 There was a fly buzzing around our heads all morning.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: To make French toast, you must first ______ the toast in a mixture of eggs and milk and then fry it.
= E
~詞義 dip（v.）沾;浸
~原文 To make French toast, you must first dip the toast in a mixture of eggs and milk and then fry it.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: My grandfather doesn't wear any store-bought clothes. Instead, he has a ______ make all his clothes for him.
= A
~詞義 tailor（n.）裁縫師
~原文 My grandfather doesn't wear any store-bought clothes. Instead, he has a tailor make all his clothes for him.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: We have pitched our ______ next to the lake.
= C
~詞義 tent（n.）帳篷
~原文 We have pitched our tent next to the lake.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: Sandra decided to step out of her comfort ______ and participate in a public speech contest.
= D
~詞義 zone（n.）舒適圈(comfort zone)
~原文 Sandra decided to step out of her comfort zone and participate in a public speech contest.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: shepherd
B: wisdom
C: cheeks
D: dirty
E: shiny
F: thumbs

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: The director gave the team the ______ up after seeing how well they handled the presentation.
= F
~詞義 thumb（n.）對某人豎起大拇指(表示讚許 give sb. the thumbs up)
~原文 The director gave the team the thumbs up after seeing how well they handled the presentation.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Every day, the ______ leads his flock of sheep to the top of the hill in the morning.
= A
~詞義 shepherd（n.）牧羊人
~原文 Every day, the shepherd leads his flock of sheep to the top of the hill in the morning.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Whenever Lucy sees the boy she likes, her ______ turn red with shyness.
= C
~詞義 cheek（n.）臉頰
~原文 Whenever Lucy sees the boy she likes, her cheeks turn red with shyness.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: It is the maid's job to wipe the floor until it is clean and ______.
= E
~詞義 shiny（adj.）發光的
~原文 It is the maid's job to wipe the floor until it is clean and shiny.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: With age comes ______, but only for those willing to learn from their mistakes.
= B
~詞義 wisdom（n.）智慧
~原文 With age comes wisdom, but only for those willing to learn from their mistakes.
